OneLineDescription: Ports ENB particle-light meshes to Light Placer JSON for Community Shaders.
LongDescription: Community Shaders has no particle-light reader, so ENB Light / Particle Lights for ENB meshes are inert. This reads their marker quads and emits Light Placer JSON: position, colour and fade come from the mesh; radius is estimated and tunable, since the mesh does not carry it.
